name: La Villa Gallo-Romaine
description: The original Puy du Fou hotel opened 2007 — a Roman villa in Gaul with mosaics, frescoes and colonnaded courtyard. Dramatically expanded in 2025 with a full Gallo-Roman street. Children under 11 get 2-day park tickets free. Breakfast included. From approximately 190 euros per room per night.

rooms.name: Roman Chamber
rooms.description: Room with Roman mosaic decor, courtyard views, breakfast buffet and 2-day park tickets for under-11s free.

rooms.name: Imperial Suite
rooms.description: Spacious suite with separate living area, terrace, enhanced Roman decor and priority show seating.

name: La Citadelle
description: A full-scale medieval castle hotel — four-poster beds, stone walls, tapestries and armour. Castle courtyard playgrounds and the medieval banquet restaurant L Ecuyer Tranchant by torchlight. Children under 11 get 2-day tickets free. From approximately 220 euros per room per night.

rooms.name: Knights Chamber
rooms.description: Medieval castle room with stone walls, tapestries, four-poster bed, breakfast and medieval banquet dinner.

rooms.name: Seigneurial Tower Suite
rooms.description: Tower suite with 360-degree views over the Vendee, private sitting room and full medieval banquet package.

name: Le Grand Siecle
description: The only 4-star hotel at Puy du Fou — a Versailles-era royal chateau opened 2020, expanding to over 200 rooms in 2026. Gilded interiors, formal gardens and the most luxurious overnight experience in the resort. Children under 11 get 2-day tickets free. From approximately 270 euros per room per night.

rooms.name: Royal Chamber
rooms.description: 4-star Louis XIV style room with gilded decor, garden views, breakfast and priority evening show access.

rooms.name: Noble Apartment
rooms.description: Luxurious apartment suite with separate salon, private terrace and full board dining package.

name: Les Iles de Clovis
description: 50 Merovingian stilt houses above tranquil ponds — the most unique overnight experience at any European theme park. Fall asleep to frogs and birds, wake to misty dawn views over the reeds. Children under 11 get 2-day tickets free. From approximately 200 euros per room per night.

rooms.name: Merovingian Lake House
rooms.description: Stilt house above the pond with Merovingian decor, wooden walkway access, breakfast and 2-day tickets free for under-11s.

rooms.name: Royal Lake House
rooms.description: Larger stilt house with king's chamber for two adults and children's sleeping area, enhanced decor and breakfast.

name: Le Camp du Drap d Or
description: The finest luxury glamping in Europe — Renaissance pavilion tents with velvet furnishings, Persian rugs and four-poster beds recreating the legendary 1520 Field of the Cloth of Gold. Children under 11 get 2-day tickets free. From approximately 310 euros per pavilion per night.

rooms.name: Royal Pavilion Tent
rooms.description: Luxurious Renaissance canvas pavilion with four-poster bed, velvet furnishings, silver decor and breakfast.

rooms.name: Grande Tente Familiale
rooms.description: Larger family pavilion with separate children's sleeping area, enhanced Renaissance furnishings and full board.

name: Le Logis de Lescure
description: The most exclusive accommodation at Puy du Fou — just 4 luxury suites in an 18th century Vendean manor. Each suite named after a Vendean hero. Ultimate privacy and luxury. Children under 11 get 2-day tickets free. From approximately 350 euros per suite per night.

rooms.name: Suite Lescure
rooms.description: One of four exclusive suites in this intimate 18th century manor — antique furnishings, fine art and breakfast.

rooms.name: Suite Deluxe
rooms.description: The largest suite with private sitting room, garden terrace and full board dining package.
